Subject: Split invoicing for multi-entity payments

Hi Camila,

Hope you’re well. Sundown is finalizing the SOW and procurement asked whether Redwood can issue split invoices across our US and EU legal entities. The ask is:

- Invoice A to Sundown Health, Inc. (US) for product & services to be paid via ACH
- Invoice B to Sundown Health EU Ltd (Ireland) for EU-registered subscriptions, VAT handling via reverse-charge
- Each invoice needs line-level cost center tags so our GL can post directly (we use ACC- codes)

I attached our PO (Sundown_PO_2219.pdf). Are you able to: 1) confirm the process and 2) provide a sample invoice template we can validate with procurement? Also let us know whether you need separate tax IDs and remit addresses for each invoice.

Thanks — looking to close the SOW and get the first invoice out next week.

Best,
Anya
Procurement Manager
Sundown Health

Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Split invoicing for multi-entity payments

Hi Anya — thanks for the PO and for laying out the requirements. We can absolutely do segmented invoicing. High-level proposed workflow:

1) You provide entity mapping (legal name, tax IDs, remit addresses, preferred payment rails) — one-time for the engagement.
2) We generate separate invoices per legal entity, with identical line items split by the billing allocation you confirm.
3) Each line will include a custom cost_center field (your ACC- codes) and a reference column that your ERP can import.
4) For EU VAT, we will mark the invoice for reverse-charge and include your VAT number on the invoice; our finance team will not apply VAT when reverse-charge applies.

I’ve attached a mutual action plan (Sundown_MAPlan_v1.xlsx) that proposes milestones and who-owns-what to get invoices issued and paid. Questions for you:
- Can you confirm the two legal entity names + invoices remit addresses and the exact cost_center values you want on each line?
- Do you require invoices delivered to Ariba/Oracle or simply emailed to finance+billing@orbitalhealth.com?

Action: If you send the mapping we’ll lock the invoice template and Ben will produce the first split invoice for approval. Expected turnaround: 2 business days after mapping receipt.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

On Wed, 11 Aug 2027 at 09:18, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’ve attached a mutual action plan ...

Thanks — looping in finance details so there’s no surprise. A few implementation notes from our side:

- We’ll emit two invoice PDFs: one addressed to Sundown Health, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) and one to Sundown Health EU Ltd (VAT: IE1234567F). Please confirm those identifiers.
- Line-level cost centers: provide the ACC- codes in a CSV or in the MA plan; our billing system accepts a single cost_center field per line (max 32 chars).
- Payment rails: ACH for the US invoice (we’ll include bank account + ACH remittance instructions). For EU payments, we will accept SEPA or wire; provide beneficiary IBAN if SEPA is preferred.
- VAT: If you confirm EU entity & VAT #, we’ll set the EU invoice to 0% VAT with a reverse-charge note: "VAT reverse-charge applies - customer to account for VAT."
- If procurement needs invoices uploaded to Ariba, include the Ariba ID in the PO metadata; otherwise we’ll email invoices to finance+billing@orbitalhealth.com and cc your AP queue.

Attached is a filled sample invoice template (InvoiceTemplate_Sundown_v2.xlsx) showing how lines will map to cost centers and GL codes.

Let us know the mapping before Monday and we’ll aim to send the first pair of invoices by Wednesday.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
